name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Implement a shared, real-time dashboard that tracks the status of every pending video ID across all departments. Product Ops owns it. The trade-off is slower initial setup for faster, transparent coordination later.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s dashboard risks becoming a stale artifact teams ignore if it lacks a built-in enforcement mechanism—like tying video IDs to active approvals in the AI Executive Assistant’s workflow. A better alternative: Product Ops enforces that no video ID moves to production without a timestamped entry in the dashboard, and the AI EA auto-flags stale entries weekly. That settles it: the dashboard is only useful if it’s the single source of truth, not just another spreadsheet.
